operation.description: Lists the members of an account. A member is one buyer's relationship with the account, regardless of how many memberships they hold.

parameters.description: The account to list members for (`biz_` tag). Defaults to the account the credential acts as.
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: Filter by what the member can reach on the account.
parameters.name: access_level

parameters.description: Filter by whether the member is still part of the account.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only return members whose users match these `user_` identifiers.
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.description: Only return members whose `most_recent_action` is one of these values.
parameters.name: most_recent_actions

parameters.description: `active` returns members holding at least one membership that currently grants access; `inactive` returns members holding at least one membership that does not. Combined with `product_ids`, `variant_ids`, or `promo_code_ids`, one membership must match all of them.
parameters.name: membership_status

parameters.description: Only return members holding a membership to one of these products, prefixed `prod_`. Unknown IDs match nothing.
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.description: Only return members holding a membership on one of these variants, prefixed `plan_`. Unknown IDs match nothing.
parameters.name: variant_ids

parameters.description: Only return members holding a membership bought with one of these promo codes, prefixed `promo_`. Unknown IDs match nothing.
parameters.name: promo_code_ids

parameters.description: Only return members this affiliate referred, prefixed `aff_`. Requires `affiliate:basic:read` and sorts by `created_at` only. Unknown IDs match nothing.
parameters.name: affiliate_id

parameters.description: Only return members bought by these accounts, prefixed `biz_`. Unknown IDs match nothing.
parameters.name: buyer_account_ids

parameters.description: Search members by name or username. An exact email address also matches when the credential holds the member:email:read scope.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only members who joined after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Only members who joined before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Sort field. `most_recent_action_at` and `last_activity_at` place members without one first when ascending and last when descending. `needs_reply` lists customers awaiting a support reply first, ordered by their latest qualifying message. Other members follow in last-activity order. Direction applies within each group. Requires `support_chat:read`.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Sort direction.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the start of the range.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: Return results after this cursor. Use `page_info.end_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the end of the range.
parameters.name: last

parameters.description: Return results before this cursor. Use `page_info.start_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Set to `true` to return the number of matching results in `page_info.total_count`. Send `first=0` as well to return the count without any results.
parameters.name: include_total_count

total_count.description: Number of results matching the filters, across every page. Counting stops at 10,000. `null` when `include_total_count` isn't `true`, or when the count ran out of time.

total_count_capped.description: Whether counting stopped at the limit. `true` means `total_count` is 10,000 or more.

access_level.description: What the member can reach on the account: `customer` for paying members, `admin` for team members, `no_access` once every grant has lapsed.

account_id.description: The account this member belongs to, prefixed `biz_`.

buyer_account_id.description: The business that bought, prefixed `biz_`. `null` when the buyer is a person.

created_at.description: When the member record was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

display_name.description: The name to show for this member: the user's name, or their username when they have not set one. The buying business's name when `user` is `null`.

earnings_usd.description: The user's gross income across Whop, in USD, refreshed periodically. `null` when the user hides their earnings or the buyer is another business.

email.description: The user's email address. `null` without `member:email:read` on the account, when the buyer is another business, or when the user has no assigned email.

joined_at.description: When the member first joined the account, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

last_accessed_at.description: When the member last opened the account's content, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` if they never have.

last_activity.description: What happened at `last_activity_at`. `object` says which kind of activity it is. `null` without `support_chat:read` on the account, or when `last_activity_at` is `null`.

last_activity_at.description: When the member and the account last interacted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. For example, a message in the member's support chat.

metadata.description: Your own key-value data stored on this member. `null` when none is set.

most_recent_action.description: The member's latest lifecycle state on the account, derived from their memberships, such as `paid_subscriber`, `canceling`, or `churned`. `null` until it is first computed.

most_recent_action_at.description: When `most_recent_action` took effect, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when `most_recent_action` is `null`.

name.description: The name the account gave this customer with `PATCH /members/:id`. Invoices show it as the customer name on every invoice for this member, in place of the user's own name. `null` when the account has not set one.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number: the most recent number collected (or verified) at checkout, otherwise their account number when they have shared one with this seller. `null` without `member:phone:read` on the account, or when there is neither.

status.description: `joined` while the member is part of the account, `left` after they leave.

token_balance.description: The member's current token balance for this account, computed from token transactions.

unsubscribe_status.description: `unsubscribed` once the member opts out of the account's marketing communications, `null` while they're subscribed. Only the member can change it.

usd_total_spent.description: How much the member has spent on the account's products, in USD.

user.description: The user behind this member. `null` when the buyer is another business rather than a person.

last_24_hours.description: Gross income in USD over the last 24 hours.

last_30_days.description: Gross income in USD over the last 30 days.

last_7_days.description: Gross income in USD over the last 7 days.

MemberLastActivity.description: What happened at the member's `last_activity_at`. `object` picks the shape: a `message` in their support chat.

amount.description: The amount in major units, as an exact decimal string. For example, `"10.00"` is ten dollars. It is a string so that no float rounds it in transit.

decimals.description: How many decimal places the amount carries. This is the precision the charge itself runs at.

display_decimals.description: How many decimal places to SHOW. Usually equal to `decimals`, and deliberately not always: COP is charged in centavos but written in whole pesos, so it is `2` and `0`. Format the number in your own locale using this.

city.description: The user's city, derived from their IP address. `null` when unknown or the user turned off location sharing.

country.description: The user's country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, like `US`, derived from their IP address. `null` when unknown or the user turned off location sharing.

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper. Its `url` is always present, and is a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

state.description: The user's state or region code, like `CA`, derived from their IP address. `null` when unknown or the user turned off location sharing.

code.description: Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.

author.description: Who sent the message: the member, or someone on the account's team. `null` when the sender's account no longer exists.

channel_id.description: The support chat the message was sent in.

created_at.description: When the message was sent, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

plain_content.description: The message text without formatting. `null` when the message has no text, such as an attachment on its own.

url.description: Avatar image URL. Always present. It is a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper. Its `url` is always present, and is a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.
